Package ui

Class ConciergeScreen

java.lang.Object
ui.ConciergeScreen
public class ConciergeScreen extends Object
JavaFX controller for the Concierge Staff screen (ConciergeScreen.fxml).

This screen allows hotel administrators to manage concierge staff. It provides:

  • Add Concierge — enter a full name and select an assigned hotel, then persist a new Concierge record.
  • Delete Concierge — enter a concierge ID to permanently remove the staff member. Will fail with a database error if the concierge is still referenced by existing experience records.
  • Staff Overview — a summary panel showing the total number of concierge staff and the number of distinct hotels that have at least one concierge.
  • All Concierges table — a live read-only table showing every concierge, their ID, full name, and assigned hotel ID.

The controller is instantiated and injected by the JavaFX FXMLLoader when ConciergeScreen.fxml is loaded.

    • updateStaffOverview

      private void updateStaffOverview(List<Concierge> list)
      Computes and updates the Staff Overview text nodes from the given concierge list.

      Hotels staffed is calculated by counting distinct hotel IDs across all concierge records using a stream pipeline. Both text nodes are guarded against null to tolerate FXML injection failures gracefully.

      Parameters:
      list - the current list of all concierge records; must not be null

    • addConcierge

      private void addConcierge()
      Handles the "+ ADD CONCIERGE" button action.

      Validates that the name field is non-empty and a hotel has been selected, resolves the selected hotel index to a hotel ID via hotelIds, creates and persists a new Concierge, then clears the form and reloads the table.

      Shows a warning alert on validation failure. Database errors are shown via alert and printed to stderr.

    • clearAdd

      private void clearAdd()
      Handles the "CLEAR" button action on the Add Concierge form. Clears the name field and resets the hotel combo selection.

    • deleteConcierge

      private void deleteConcierge()
      Handles the "DELETE CONCIERGE" button action.

      Validates that a numeric concierge ID has been entered, then calls ConciergeDAO.deleteConcierge(int). Clears the ID field and reloads the table on success. Shows a warning alert if the ID is missing or non-numeric, or if a database error occurs (e.g. FK violation because the concierge is still referenced by experience records).
